FROM CONVERSATION TO CONTEXT

A place to return to.

01 / RECORD

Stay in the meeting.

Capture your microphone and system audio on your Mac. Stop recording to save the audio locally.

02 / TRANSCRIBE

Read it in your own time.

Choose Transcribe when you need the words. Premium sends the recording for cloud processing after your consent.

03 / ASK

Follow the evidence.

Ask about the meeting you have open. Follow citations to transcript segments and play the audio behind them.

A CLEAR CHOICE

Local recording.
Optional cloud transcription.

Keep the audio, transcript, and meeting history on your Mac. Premium adds managed cloud transcription when you need it, through monthly or annual subscriptions.

Recording, reading saved transcripts, and citation playback remain separate from Premium. Ask uses a supported provider you choose, with its own account requirements and terms.
